Name: Kumo to Tulip
Tags: Animal Protagonists, Black and White, Family Friendly, Insects, Non-Human Protagonists, Shorts, Based on a Picture Book
Description: A jovial spider sits atop a comfortable web in a field filled with flowers, trying to lure any insect into its clutches. When a beautiful ladybug gets within reach, he coaxes her to the web, saying it's fun - and thus begins her daring and dangerous adventure! Luckily, a fellow flying friend, a tulip and a thunderstorm ensure that the ladybug will manage to escape scot free.

Name: Momotaro's Sea Eagle
Tags: Black and White, Historical, War, World War 2
Description: Momotaro, the human leader of an animal navy fleet, has given his animal vassals a mission to bomb Pearl Harbor (also referred to as Demon Island). The Canine, Monkey, & Pheasant units all volunteered to accomplish the mission in the honor of their own country.
